title: AI ETHICS ISSUES IN REAL WORLD: EVIDENCE FROM AI INCIDENT DATABASE
benchmark_measurement: Bias against Jewish people (anti-Semitism) in language models and recommendation systems.
findings: The paper identified incidents of anti-Semitism in AI systems. For example, Google's Natural Language API provided anti-Semitic sentiment analyses (Incident 16), and Google Images showed anti-Semitic results for the search 'Jewish baby stroller' due to the algorithm learning from maliciously tagged data (Incident 82).
